title: A second fix check may start from the previous fix check's head
why: `merge --review-record` allows one Fix check line per record chain, so a second small fix (most often a main merge plus a form fix during lane lint) forces a fresh full round. On Nov 7 it hit #1679, #1670, #1439 and q_max #1106, each costing a full reviewer round for a delta with no behaviour change (coordinator, 23:29 CST). Rule roles-review-cap-three: a small fix to a round's finding gets a fix check and merges on green.
note: Fix: allow a later fix check whose base is the previous fix check's head. Not covered by open PRs: #1780 makes a failed fix check count as the next round; #1575 allows a fix base across a notes-only commit or from another PR's record (triage read both PR bodies, 23:33 CST). Stack on #1575. A queue fix under the item 384 hold. Slug from the coordinator; title by triage. 23:31 CST: lane fail-record-ancestor-head takes it as a second PR, stacked after its current one, because it owns the same fix-check code in merge.py (coordinator). The fail-record-ancestor-head lane continues here after #1795 closed (coordinator, 00:02 CST Nov 8). Ruling check (triage, 02:24 CST Nov 8): owner item 347 a (review-fix-check-round, 13:12 CST Nov 7) rules that a failed fix check counts as the next review round, inside the three-round cap; #1780 builds it. Item 356 is a different ruling (a round-3 FAIL holds). So this step follows item 347: a FAIL fix check never sends the change back to round 1. The coordinator's standing answer of 23:35 CST Nov 7 (a fresh round 1 when a chain cannot take a fix check) applies only where no failed fix check exists: a newest record that already holds a passing fix check, or a round head with no record. Clash caught by lane comment-check-scans-shell on #1834. Sighting (lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, 04:50 CST Nov 8): #1461 and #1481 had a round-2 fix check, then took a merge of #1417's new head 71b0be6a7; `merge --review-record --fix-check` refused a second fix check ("the reviewed head must be the Head of the newest earlier review record on this pull request, and that record must have no Fix check line"). Under the coordinator's standing answer, #1461, #1481, #1825 and #1836 each take a fresh round 1 of a new record. Gap review-record-round-heads, not covered by #1839 (lane verdict-instruction-false-alarm via the coordinator, 04:52 CST Nov 8): `merge --review-record` does not tie each `--round` to the head it read, so a record can list rounds 1 to 3 at a head they never read (#1376's record at f9be8c53). Fix: each round line carries the head it read, and the tool refuses a round whose head is not an ancestor of the record head, or that has a change after it other than reviewed fixes. Sighting for gap review-record-round-heads (lane revive-1042, 05:16 CST Nov 8): `merge <pr> --review-record` printed a round line for head ddeebc925 while round 2's reviewer read 56fbeb257. The lane's proposed step record-head-matches-review is folded here. Owner item 402 a (06:08 CST Nov 8) changes the coordinator's standing answer in #1839's wording: for a guard or check change, a fresh chain runs rounds 1-3 with the net-value test at round 3, not round 1 alone; a change with no guard or check keeps a fresh round 1 (coordinator, 06:33 CST). #1839's lane rewords it. Item 402 a's reword is PR 1957, stacked on top of the stack (Merge after: PR 1951), not an edit to #1839, so #1839's record and the stacked bases stay valid. It rewords decision pr-review-record and the --fix-base-record remedy; round 1 review running (lane, 06:45 CST Nov 8). #1829 (chained fix checks after a passed one) is held from runner 8 on page item 418, fix-checks-chain; round 3 PASS (sonnet), net value zero at f812874cd (coordinator, 06:38 CST Nov 8). Item 418 measured line (coordinator, 06:39 CST): one PR tonight (#1892) needed two more small fixes after a passed fix check, so a chain would have saved 2 rounds on 1 PR. The coordinator told the lane to move six PRs stacked on #1829 off it. Measured case added to page item 418 (coordinator, 07:58 CST Nov 8): #1471's fix check failed only on a wrong Drops-lines commit (df5a181c2, not ad1f43bd5). Owner item 418 b (10:05 CST Nov 8): #1829 closes; a second fix after a passed fix check starts a fresh chain. Owner note: "we can maybe allow a limit to chaining but allow it?" The lane shapes a new page question: a chain of at most N fix checks, then a fresh chain, with N measured from past PRs. Until answered, b holds. 10:17 CST Nov 8: the capped-chain question is page item 426 (fix-check-chain-cap).
